label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue is caused by the password reset email link using the environment variable PUBLIC_URL for the base URL, which currently defaults to "http://localhost:3000" if PUBLIC_URL is not set. To fix this, ensure that the deployment environment sets PUBLIC_URL to the correct production URL so the reset password links in emails point to the right domain instead of localhost.

input.title: Fix password reset email to use correct base URL instead of localhost
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently uses BASE_URL which falls back to "http://localhost:3000" when PUBLIC_URL environment variable is not set. This causes the reset-password link in the email to incorrectly point to localhost, making the link unusable for users who receive the email.

The proposed change is to update the email template to use the correct base URL configured for the production environment instead of defaulting to localhost. This likely involves ensuring PUBLIC_URL is properly set in production or adjusting the fallback for BASE_URL to a valid public URL rather than localhost.
